children: Isabella Bank announced mailing election materials for Grand River shareholders and set an Oct. 23 election deadline.
Election materials mailed Sept. 28 to Grand River holders of record as of Sept. 24 for merger consideration choices.
Shareholders must submit Election Form to Continental Stock Transfer by 5:00 p.m. ET on Oct. 23, 2026 (deadline may be extended).
Per-share cash consideration estimated at approximately $5.71 based on assumed 9,136,529 Grand River shares outstanding.
Exchange ratio estimated at 0.1413 Isabella shares per Grand River share, subject to adjustment and proration.
Merger remains subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions; expected to close in Q4 2026.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Isabella Bank to mail election materials for Grand River merger; cash est. $5.71 or 0.1413 share ratio
